definitions.explanation: The bracket pair { } named for its wavy shape. Used in mathematics, programming, and some kinds of notation, rarely in ordinary Japanese writing.

examples.japanese: {波括弧|なみかっこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧。
⟦プログラム→プログラム：01540_puroguramu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{波括弧|なみかっこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Curly brackets are used a lot in programs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{集合|しゅうごう}→集合：03068_shuugou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{要素|ようそ}→要素：03661_youso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{波括弧|なみかっこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
examples.english: When writing a set, you list its elements inside curly brackets.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧ (wave) + ⟦{括弧|かっこ}→括弧：00151_kakko⟧ (bracket). Also called {中括弧|ちゅうかっこ}, since it is often the middle level between ( ) and [ ].
